cases.name: A refund stored as a positive amount
cases.harm: Net sales are too high for one store, so its manager is overpaid.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: The row is set aside. The store waits: do not pay yet
finished_pipeline.recovery: The store sends a corrected file. Monday is run again

cases.name: One receipt in the file twice, with different line ids
cases.harm: The key is still unique. One receipt is counted twice.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: The extra copies are set aside. The day is right again, and the store is paid
finished_pipeline.who_is_told: Nobody. A message in the digest

cases.name: A weight entered in grams, not kilograms
cases.harm: One line of bananas costs more than the store's whole day.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: The row is set aside. The store waits: do not pay yet
finished_pipeline.recovery: The store sends a corrected file. Thursday is run again

cases.name: A price that was changed yesterday, charged at the old price
cases.harm: Each line is valid. The store took less money than the price list says.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: A warning. The sales number is right, and the store is paid
finished_pipeline.recovery: The store updates the prices in its tills

cases.name: A sale at 03:10 in a store that closes at 22:00
cases.harm: The sale lands on Monday, in the next bonus week.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: The rows are set aside. The store waits: do not pay yet
finished_pipeline.recovery: The store sends a corrected file. Sunday is run again

cases.name: A sale for a product that is not in products
cases.harm: The join drops the lines silently, and sales are too low.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: The lines are recorded from the raw rows. The store waits: do not pay yet
finished_pipeline.recovery: The buying team types the product. Saturday is run again

cases.name: One store sends no file
cases.harm: Every check passes: there are no rows to fail. A whole day is missing.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: The other five stores are published. This store waits: no sales file arrived
finished_pipeline.recovery: None by Monday. This is the one store that cannot be paid

cases.name: One store's file arrives a day late
cases.harm: Yesterday's number is low, and changes tomorrow.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: The store waits for one night. Freshness names the file: 23.7 hours late
finished_pipeline.who_is_told: Head of retail operations, then closed the next night
finished_pipeline.recovery: None needed. The file arrives by itself

cases.name: One store's whole file sent twice
cases.harm: Sales for that store double for the day.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: The copies of the second file are set aside. The day is right again
finished_pipeline.who_is_told: Nobody. A message in the digest

cases.name: The supplier renames a column
cases.harm: The load runs. The cost column is empty, so the order has no cost.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: The file is refused. The last good costs stay in use
finished_pipeline.recovery: The supplier sends a file that keeps the contract

cases.name: The supplier sends cost in cents
cases.harm: Every cost is 100 times too high, and still a valid number.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: The file is refused by the contract. The last good costs stay in use
finished_pipeline.recovery: The supplier sends a file in dollars

cases.name: A stock count is missing for one day
cases.harm: The gap is read as zero stock, and the store over-orders.
caught_by: A snapshot has a row for every day

finished_pipeline.what_happens: A warning. The order list says: no count, order by hand

cases.name: The same member twice, with different letter case in the email
cases.harm: Two emails to one person, and two sets of points.

finished_pipeline.what_happens: The newer member is set aside, by number only. One email is sent

not_wrong.name: A public holiday with low sales
not_wrong.why: Founders' Day. The stores open from 10:00 to 16:00

not_wrong.name: A store closed for one day
not_wrong.why: A planned refit. No files, and that is correct

not_wrong.name: A real sale of 400 items
not_wrong.why: A café buys 400 bottles of still water at $0.59
